about_the_game:
This long-abandoned tea house is now in your hands, thanks to an invitation from your grandfather, making you its new young owner. To save up for university tuition, you must work hard and manage the business diligently!

In your little yard, you can cultivate various tea leaves or change the decorations to suit your taste. As more customers gradually visit, they might bring you new recipes as gifts. Building relationships with them can lead to deepening friendships or even romance.

By personally crafting tea blends and managing the tea house, your goal is to develop it into a renowned chain store! This journey will not only bring you a great sense of accomplishment but will also slowly unveil the truth of the past.

You're the boss now!

Oversee everything from crafting individual drinks to passing official Tea Association reviews. Grow your tea house and make it a success!

Decorate to Your Heart's Content!

Let's be honest: the tea house's initial condition is... a bit rough, to put it mildly. It certainly has room for improvement!

And the tea garden? A pitiful sight, looking as though it's been through one too many storms, standing as a silent lament. But fear not! With your touch, you can purchase all sorts of decorations and transform everything to your liking!

Build Meaningful Connections!

This humble tea house attracts an astonishing crowd. But don't worry, this isn't a spy thriller—it's more like... a once-quiet community that has become bustling and joyful since your arrival. You might meet sharp corporate professionals, multi-talented Renaissance persons, a charismatic heiress, or even a business titan! Who knows? Your interactions with them may blossom with complex emotions, but whether as customers or friends, they will become your most loyal companions.

The Truth Behind It All?!

Dealing with the mess left by your eccentric grandfather is one thing. But as your business expands, you'll uncover more clues that lead you to the truth of what happened years ago. And when all the pieces surface, you'll be faced with a final, weighty decision...

More Than Tea!

Expand your business far beyond the cup. Craft adorable merchandise, care for pets, and launch new locations!

Wishlist us Now and be the first to get updates!

short_description: Nestled on a quiet street, a cozy tea house awaits its new owner. In this game, you can craft, unlock, and cultivate a variety of teas. Manage your tea house: Association reviews, get to know your customers, and even find romance. Meanwhile, the mysteries behind all will gradually unravel.
